angle_digest.py.text:
import sys,struct,hashlib,json
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);from sim import angle_degrees
xs=[-1.,-.5,0.,.5,1.]
for i in range(4096):
 w=int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(str(i).encode()).digest()[:8],'big')>>11
 xs.append(-1.+2.*w/(2**53-1))
raw=b''.join(struct.pack('>d',angle_degrees(x)) for x in xs)
print(json.dumps({'samples':len(xs),'binary64_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}))
